data.desc: Live Nation Entertainment (NYSE: LYV) promotes the shows that bring artists to their fans. Since 2005, we've connected artists with more than 1.5 billion fans across 55 countries. A live concert is more than a show - it's a moment fans wait all year for, travel for, and remember for a lifetime. Live Nation exists to make more of those moments possible, helping artists grow their careers and bringing more live music to more fans, everywhere.
